subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should OpenClaw accept this Doctor-required one-way device-identity cutover, including fail-closed legacy files and unsupported downgrade/mixed-version sharing after migration?
rationale: The implementation deliberately changes the supported upgrade and rollback contract for cryptographic device identity; source review cannot determine whether that operational tradeoff is acceptable for existing deployments.

options.title: Accept after recovery proof
options.body: Approve the documented one-way cutover after the reset regression is fixed and a redacted legacy-import and post-import runtime proof is attached.

options.title: Preserve a compatibility path
options.body: Require an explicit, supported upgrade or rollback strategy for older JSON-only processes before accepting the canonical SQLite cutover.

recommendation.title: Accept after recovery proof
recommendation.body: Approve the documented one-way cutover after the reset regression is fixed and a redacted legacy-import and post-import runtime proof is attached.
